svg.title: ES Paris
svg.desc: Étoile Sportive de Paris (FR-4), Paris — Football Architect. Symmetric historic heraldic shield featuring Notre-Dame de Paris, a five-pointed star, paired fleurs-de-lis and outlined club lettering. Four editable named layers. Approved colors: #194979 and #FFFFFF.

path.inkscape:label: Central spire and upper cornice · symmetric
